description.value: A single RV/camping pitch at a small private riverside retreat on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar, reached via the gravel Nahatlatch FSR off Highway 1; open April through Thanksgiving with shared washroom facilities on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rivers Edge Cabins is an active seasonal property on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar, BC, open April 1 through Thanksgiving, currently offering 2 riverfront cabins and 1 RV/camping spot after wildfire recovery. OSM tags (access=yes, fee=yes, tourism=camp_site) are broadly consistent with the website, though OSM's payment:cash=yes conflicts with the website listing Visa, MasterCard, debit, and e-transfers as accepted payment methods. The 'Log Creek Campground' OSM name appears only in the URL path and not prominently in the website's own text, which consistently uses 'Rivers Edge Cabins'.
concerns: OSM tag payment:cash=yes conflicts with website listing Visa, MasterCard, debit cards, and e-transfers as accepted payment methods.
Only 1 RV/Camping spot currently available due to ongoing post-wildfire recovery; capacity is very limited.
OSM name 'Log Creek Campground' does not appear in the body text of the website; the operator consistently uses 'Rivers Edge Cabins' — the 'log_creek' label appears only in the URL path.
OSM community is listed as 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but Boston Bar / Nahatlatch River is geographically in the Fraser Canyon, not the Okanagan & Thompson region.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating campsite in a scenic and remote Fraser Canyon location; despite very limited camping capacity (1 spot post-wildfire), it is a useful waypoint for touring cyclists travelling Highway 1 toward or from the Nahatlatch area.
